title_en: A Day in a Fishing Village
note_en: 一…就… means "as soon as... (then)...": 新鲜的鱼一上岸，就马上被摆进冰块里 "as soon as the fresh fish comes ashore, it is packed straight into ice." English puts "as soon as" at the start of the clause, but Chinese tucks 一 right before the first verb and 就 before the second, after any subject: 渔船一靠岸，工厂的人就立刻上前.
